metadata.description: RUSHYOP agent plugins/skills (Claude + Cursor). First-party under plugins/; upstream via public RUSHYOP mirrors. Local wire: ./scripts/apply-cursor.sh

plugins.name: agent-tooling
plugins.description: General agent skills: find-skills, git-commit, graphify, migrate-radix-to-base, project-sites, shadcn.

plugins.name: android-dev-skills
plugins.description: Curated community Android development skills complementing the official android-skills plugin (no overlap): Material/Android design (wshobson), clean architecture, Kotlin coroutines/flows, Kotlin patterns (everything-claude-code).

plugins.name: android-skills
plugins.description: Official Android skills for AI agents (android/skills upstream): Compose styles/migration/adaptive, CameraX, Navigation 3, Perfetto tracing + SQL, R8, AGP 9 upgrade, Play Billing/Engage/policy, testing strategy, edge-to-edge, Wear, XR glasses, AppFunctions, intent security, verified email, android CLI.
